text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 — spike in srv-resolution errors in us-west-2b (internal service discovery). 220 errors/min for _*_._tcp.model-services over last 3m. Paging @emily-oncall and @sre-jordan

emily-oncall: on it, pulling metrics and logs now. dashboards show a sharp jump at ~2149990000

sre-jordan: seeing consul leader churn in us-west-2b around the same time. raft timeouts in logs. possible quorum instability.

raj-net: FYI we pushed an AZ peering BGP tweak ~20m ago to improve cross-AZ egress. Could be related.

emily-oncall: question: is this DNS (CoreDNS) or SRV data in Consul? need to narrow.

sre-jordan: quick dig against node-local coredns: `dig +short SRV _model._tcp.model-svc.consul @10.12.4.2` returns mixed ports (old 3100 and new 3200 intermittently). That smells like inconsistent cache state across CoreDNS pods.

emily-oncall: grabbing coredns pod logs

raj-net: pasted from `kubectl logs coredns-84f -n kube-system`:
```
2026-03-14T21:06:41Z [ERROR] plugin/cache: cache miss eviction race: key=SRV/_model._tcp.model-svc.consul
2026-03-14T21:06:42Z [WARN] upstream: connection reset by peer
```

maria-csm: reports from CS: two internal teams saw intermittent failures in model-router lookups — degraded, not total outage. No external customer 5xxs reported yet.

emily-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale CoreDNS in us-west-2b 3->6 2) restart CoreDNS deployment to flush caches 3) check Consul raft health and consider rolling leader promotion if needed.

sre-jordan: scaling now — `kubectl scale deployment/coredns -n kube-system --replicas=6`. Deploy rolled out.

emily-oncall: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/coredns -n kube-system` executed to force cache flush across pods.

deploy-bot: runbook step completed: svc-discovery-cache-flush by emily-oncall at 2149990165

raj-net: checking consul peers: `consul operator raft list-peers` shows intermittent `leader: 10.12.8.7` switching to `10.12.8.9` then back. There are delayed heartbeats.

emily-oncall: errors dropped to ~18/min after scaling + restart. Good signal.

raj-net: I rolled back the recent BGP peering tweak at 2149990200 — routing tables restored. I also validated inter-AZ latency on internal mesh — now stable.

sre-jordan: after route rollback & coredns restart, SRV queries stable: `1000 queries -> 0.1% errors, consistent ports=3200`.

emily-oncall: immediate customer impact: ~12 internal services experienced increased latency/lookup failures for ~18 minutes (2149990000–2149990180). No external-facing 500s. We'll mark severity reduced to P2.

maria-csm: I’ll prepare a short note to affected product teams: include timeline, mitigation, and confirmation no customer-facing outages.

sre-jordan: preliminary root cause hypothesis: BGP peering change caused asymmetric paths and transient packet loss to a subset of Consul servers, leading to raft leader instability and KV propagation delays. CoreDNS pods then served cached SRV records from mixed state (some pods with updated registrations, some with stale), leading to inconsistent resolution. Also saw a handful of registrations with TTL=0 which prevented normal cache expiry behavior.

emily-oncall: action items (short):
- rc: postmortem ticket (SVC-INC-214999) — assigned to sre-jordan
- networking: add safety rollback/verify step to peering change runbook — assigned to raj-net
- runtime: add cache-invalidation endpoint/runbook for CoreDNS & add aggressive health checks for consul leader churn — assigned to emily-oncall
- CSM: customer comms draft — assigned to maria-csm

raj-net: I’ll also add BGP convergence tests to our preflight for peering changes.

maria-csm: drafting outreach now, will loop in trust & security if needed.

sre-jordan: creating postmortem template and will include logs, dig traces, consul raft history, and timeline.

emily-oncall: handing off monitoring & long-running tasks to raj-net for network follow-ups. I’ll stay on the postmortem and verification steps.

emily-oncall: final status: mitigated, resolution actions in progress, monitoring stable for 15m.

incident-bot: Incident state changed: P1 -> P2 at 2149990245.

maria-csm: :white_check_mark: Thanks team. Will report back with customer note draft in 1h.

sre-jordan: adding note: ensure registrator/agent that writes TTL=0 bug is tracked — saw 3 instances where service-registrator emitted TTL=0 after rolling deploys.

emily-oncall: copied. Closing paging and switching to post-incident channel when postmortem is ready.

raj-net: confirmed last metric spike cleared, no new churn in raft. Will keep watch through next 2 hours.

maria-csm: tagging this for follow-up action items in the weekly reliability review.

emily-oncall: thanks all — great coordination.
